title: Kim Scott, amplifying a reader's review — 'Incorruptible by Eric Ries is such an important book!'
summary: The author of Radical Candor reshares Sami Mäkeläinen's review of the book to her own audience, adding a one-line endorsement of her own. It is her fifth public endorsement since April.
blockquote: Incorruptible by Eric Ries is such an important book!
